items.description: Intro _This is a story about Ellen as she has to hunt down gunner an ancient robot set on destroying humans.. Explore and find hidden objects to progress through the story ...Ellen is a bionic human with super abilities to help navigate Death Moon..Death Moon is a plane filled with mysterious creature which Ellen calls "dogs" which will attack when close by. But these beings are just distraction from the real mission regardless they can still pose a threat.Game play _Ellen has a gun and a staff which would help kill the enemies and once free Ellen can search for hidden objects hidden by mist which usually mean sits close by..Explore the dense forest as you search and uncover different secretes of the old human civilization. Ellen does not have a restore point and once you quit or die its all over. But you can still find your way through since Ellen/Player is able to easily recall the artifacts and switches locations to activate and get through the level quickly. Summary _Ellen does not have a restore point which means die once or quit is game over..And also will have to plan and time reactions correctly to help get through the levels..Detail of Game play_Avoid spikes which could cost you a life bar-Try to evade by jumping over pools of acid which instantly drops you back to beginning-Avoid the Spitter dogs since they shot acid which can distract you, allowing other dogs a chance to attack-Follow mist to reveal locations of the hidden objects-Use blocks to climb through areas you could not reach by pushing or jumping onto them-Activate bridges to help get through bigger holes and obstacles Subscribe to our newsletter Get STEAM deals and FREE games in your inbox Game developers Want your game sold on DailyIndieGame? items.description: Dice Keeper is a dice-based puzzle game. Chill or try to break the world record in the first game of the Zanarka Studio. Nenetas, the dice keeper, must group dice with the same value by dragging and dropping them in order to make them disappear and score points. If the board is full, it's over. At present the early access contains the main mode which is the "endless" solo mode, it will subsequently be added alternative game modes (small puzzles, chrono, ..) and online multiplayer. items.description: If you like a challenge then you've come to the right place. This won't be another easy to beat 2d pixel game. Challenge yourself in this fun, action packed game. Unlock new abilities and attack throughout the game and new enemies. With unique bosses to fight, each different from the last. Fight in this fantasy game and take down your foes. You'll travel through multiple different worlds, all sorts of different levels, enemies, weapons and so much more. With new levels being made often. You play as a female warrior who can melee with her sword or throw axes as projectiles to kill enemies. As you progress you will unlock new ways to attack and take down your foes. You can also jump on most enemies heads to kill them. You will start at world 1 and fight through all the creatures. Once you get through there you can progress onto world 2. Which will give you lots of new things to unlock. With each world you travel to their will be many different new items, enemies, world styles, objects and many more. Take down your foes however you wish, but don't die. There is no one exact to complete each level. Every level can be beat many different ways. items.description: DESSTROKE is a demolition simulator that combines accurate demolition physics with freedom of action. You will have to make your neighbor angry by destroying every corner of his apartment.This game is an excellent anti-stress, where everyone gets an opportunity to make a little prank and smash everything around. Who could refuse such a thing? Also, after you make all your fruition a reality you'll have to get away with it...or just take it...You mistakenly walk into an apartment that isn't yours open wide and remember how you once worked at a house demolition job. But this time you decide not to demolish the whole house, but just one apartment. Of course, after all, behind the wall is yours!It will be especially interesting to draw on the walls and throw grenades, which you have in abundance. But be careful: the time until the arrival of law enforcement in the form of a robot is limited. Try to plan everything so that there is time to have fun and escape.Features :Realistic physics of destroying objectsRealistic explosion simulationStunning graphicsDestroying other people's property has never been more fun!
